scenarios.name: Apply and find the custom appearance in the document

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: a new generic appearance is open in the Appearance Editor
I change its name to "Custom Ocean Blue"
the Appearance Editor remains open with "Custom Ocean Blue" in its title
OK and Apply are disabled until another edit
I search the Appearance Browser for "Custom Ocean Blue"
the document results show "Custom Ocean Blue" with a blue preview
its type is Generic and its category is Uncategorized
the library results report no match
